title: Field widgets are validated against datatype -- pick a compatible widget for the field type
body: The platform validates field `widget` against the field's datatype (`FieldWidgetDefaults.classify`); an incompatible pairing is rejected at authoring time, a discouraged one renders but produces a `discouraged_widget` warning. Full catalog: `text`/`textarea` for string, `number`/`range` (slider, needs declared `schema.min`+`schema.max`) for int/long/decimal, `checkbox`/`toggle` for boolean, `password` for string, `date`/`datetime-local` pickers for date types, `select`/`radio`/`autocomplete` for enum-with-values or single reference, `lookup` for reference (FK) fields (automatic browse dialog), `multiselect`/`chips` for multi-reference or closed-enum arrays, `image-select` for an enum/reference with an icon or image source, `image-preview` for a file field restricted to `image/*` content types, plus `color` for string. `email`/`url` are compatible only on `string` -- both impose a native browser format constraint, so on a numeric/uuid field they silently block form submit rather than merely rendering wrong (fixed 2026-08-26; previously misclassified as discouraged). A `custom` trusted-source widget is available for bespoke UI. When in doubt, check the field's type first, then choose from the widgets that type allows.
